# Homepage artworks

These reproductions are documented as public domain by their Wikimedia Commons file pages. Local WebP files retain the source aspect ratio and composition, with responsive-size encoding for the website. The SVG wooden frame is original website code; it is not part of the historical artworks.

- `starry-night.webp`: **The Starry Night**, Vincent van Gogh, 1889. [File and provenance](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vincent_van_Gogh_Starry_Night.jpg). Source image: `https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/de/Vincent_van_Gogh_Starry_Night.jpg`.
- `wanderer.webp`: **Der Wanderer über dem Nebelmeer (Wanderer above the Sea of Fog)**, Caspar David Friedrich, c. 1818. [File and provenance](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Caspar_David_Friedrich_-_Wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog.jpg). Source image: `https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b9/Caspar_David_Friedrich_-_Wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog.jpg`.
- `leonardo.webp`: **Portrait of Leonardo da Vinci**, attributed to Francesco Melzi, c. 1515–1518. [File and provenance](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:A_portrait_of_Leonardo,_by_Francesco_Melzi.jpg). Source image: `https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b8/A_portrait_of_Leonardo%2C_by_Francesco_Melzi.jpg`.

Homepage captions and the native Artwork credits disclosure preserve attribution. Images are hosted with the website rather than relying on remote image loading. The frame entrance and settling animations finish within five seconds; reduced-motion preferences suppress motion.
